meaning: Software you talk to out loud that answers questions or does tasks on a phone or a home speaker.
clues: You can ask it about almost anything out loud, like the weather, and it answers you.
It can also make a call, send a text, or set a reminder.
It can run on a phone or on a speaker you keep at home.
Apple, Amazon, and Google each make one.
assumes: A screen reader reads what is on a screen for a person who cannot see it well
Dictation turns spoken words into typed text
An automated phone menu gives recorded choices when you call a business

decoys.meaning: Software that reads words and controls on a screen aloud for someone who needs help seeing them.
A phone feature that turns the words you speak into typed text in a text box.
A recorded phone system that gives choices and sends your call to the right place.
